title: The second annual Dads in Dev meets North Meets South meets TJ Miller Christmas Extravaganza web podcast
content: Andrew Del Prete, David Hemphill, and TJ Miller join Michael and Jake for their second annual Christmas crossover podcast. We talk about things we learned, best memories, favourite books and movies of 2017 and what we're looking forward to in 2018, as well as play a little Christmas trivia.
